apify.description: Apify Store Actors for public-web scraping, extraction, and site-specific automation

authoringHints: Use when the user wants data from public websites, marketplaces, search results, listings, reviews, maps, social profiles, product pages, docs sites, or other web pages.
Assume Apify likely already has a purpose-built Actor for many scraping tasks; prefer selecting a concrete Actor at authoring time instead of writing generic browser logic.
